title: External Organization Schema
description: Schema for representing third-party entities such as partners, regulators, standards bodies and customers

externalOrgID.description: Unique identifier for the external organization

name.description: The full name of the external organization

acronym.description: Short form of the name, e.g. APRA

type.description: Classification of the external organization. standardsBody = issues recognised standards or frameworks; legislature = makes statute law; government = a government department or agency that is not a regulator; industryBody = an industry association or professional body

description.description: Brief description of the external organization

domain.description: Industry or government domain the organization belongs to

jurisdiction.description: Legal jurisdiction the organization operates under

jurisdictionCodes.description: Jurisdictions the organization's remit covers, as codes

remit.description: For a regulator or standards body, what it regulates or standardises, e.g. 'Prudential regulation of banks, insurers and superannuation trustees'

contactInfo.description: Contact information for the external organization

monitoredSourceDataFlowIDs.description: Data flows (Dynamic and Time-Series extension) that watch this organization's publications for change
